title: Register bound from state bounds
statement: Let $E$ and $B$ be natural numbers, let $\sigma$ be a counting-algorithm state whose seventeen registers are each at most $B$, let $l$ be an optional control label, and let $res$ be an optional Boolean result. The abstract configuration with label $l$, register vector from $\sigma$, and result $res$ has every register at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $E$ determining the control-state type
A counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ with every register at most $B$
replaced:
If each of the seventeen natural-number quantities in a register state is at most $B$,
then every configuration whose register values are given by that state has all register
values at most $B$, for any machine label and any optional Boolean result.
